newsitem.title: USA: Aviation Sales Co Q1 net off, more shrs.
newsitem.headline: Aviation Sales Co Q1 net off, more shrs.

text.p: NOTE: Pro forma adjustments as if company had been taxed as a C-corporation since the beginning of the period.
1996 Q1 restated to reflect results of AvEng Trading Partners Inc, accounted for as a pooling of interests.
Q1 1997 had 59 percent more shares outstanding as a result of June 1996 IPO.
Q1 1997 sales from bearings distribution business added $5.1 million of revenues at a 22.6% gross profit margin.
Q1 1997 operating expenses increased $1.3 million due to higher sales levels.
Q1 1997 operating expenses as a percentage of sales declined to 16.7% from 19.4% in Q1 1996.
Decline in gross profit margin came as mix of inventories sold during the period continued to reflect a declining contribution from bulk inventories acquired prior to 1995, company said.
